# Deviload 2.17.0

**The song's video behind the music.** Devil Music can play a looping piece of the official video behind the full player or behind the whole music page, read the lyrics of your own files, find the song playing in one click and show how far a download has got.

- Canvas plays a silent loop from the song's official video behind the full player. A song with no video keeps its drifting cover. The switch is in the player header, and the dimming and quality are at the bottom of the Themes menu.
- The new Live theme plays the same video behind the whole music page while the full player is closed.
- Lyrics for your own files: a .lrc file beside the song comes first, then the lyrics stored in the file's tags. A file without lyrics offers to search online, song by song; nothing is sent on its own. Thanks for asking in #37.
- Find the song playing: the crosshair beside the heart on the player bar, or the J key, scrolls the list to the song that plays and makes it glow, even in long lists. Thanks for asking in #38.
- Songs you download from Devil Music show their progress on the player bar, then open their folder in one click.

### Devil Music

The playing song's row is tinted in the cover's colour with moving bars, in every theme. New features are introduced once with a dot and a single tip.

### Fixes

A song that will not start, even after the retries and the search for another version, is skipped with a short note instead of stopping the music. Connection problems and YouTube limits still stop, so the rest of the queue is not wasted. The version button is now a small chip that no longer covers the message.

Opening and closing the full player, switching pages, opening the library and refreshing the home are smoother. The full player no longer shows a stripe on the right, and the sound mood badge no longer covers the Next button. The vinyl disc no longer turns into a green square.

On Windows, run the setup EXE over your installed copy to keep your library and settings.
